deposition_provenance.scope: Fixed year-2000 coarse model climatology for subsequent runs; not site observations or a historical trend
deposition_provenance.nitrogen_time_convention: Constant rate using source noleap year of 365 days; a Gregorian leap year receives 366/365 of this annual amount
deposition_provenance.aerosol_time_convention: Cyclic linear interpolation of calendar-month midpoint rates, actual Gregorian month lengths, evaluated at forcing interval midpoint
limitations: Organic carbon is present in source but not in the five-tracer snow model; excluded, not silently added to BC.
Hydrophilic and hydrophobic BC deposition are summed into the model single BC tracer.
Aerosol filename/date identify 2000, but global case/history includes 1850 labels. Actual arrays differ from the separately downloaded 1850 file; metadata inconsistency is retained.
N is annual offline NOy+NHx deposition, not the newer CLM5 monthly nitrogen dataset.
Positive deposition accumulates total system N in the simplified current BGC model without leaching/denitrification; total-N equilibrium is not claimed.
